name: Material Sample
description: Sample for MaterialBlock: two swords on materials written from nothing, with no game material named. Frost Steel Sword's are blocks written by hand in blocks/materials.json; Ember Sword's are made by modelcook from its glTF's own materials. A spark effect takes a particle's look from a material. Every player needs it: materials are drawn by the client. Build the assets first: build-assets.sh (reads the installed game, writes assets/).
